basis: B52 (P-334 (5)); moved from api/src/own-yes-no.ts to data by B88 (P-319). Per combination, the application form whose Yes/No form fields worked out from other answers are each asked as their own question, in the form's words: IMM 5257 (09-2023) p. 1 Question 2 A "Have you ever used any other name such as a nickname, maiden name or alias?"; p. 2 "Do you have a national identity document?"; p. 2 "Are you a lawful Permanent Resident of the United States with a valid alien registration card (green card)?". The library field of the same name is used when there is one (IMM 0008's and IMM 1294's field maps name them so). Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. B116 (founder's ruling on #1123, 6 Nov 2026: the product fills every box Validate insists on, never a hand tick): three form fields no saved AI answer mapped are asked too, for every applicant, minors included, in the form's words: Background information Question 1 a) "Within the past two years, have you or a family member ever had tuberculosis of the lungs or been in close contact with a person with tuberculosis?"; Question 6 "Have you ever witnessed or participated in the ill treatment of prisoners or civilians, looting or desecration of religious buildings?"; the consent "Do you consent to be contacted by CIC, or an organization at CIC's request, in the future?" (its reading prints Question 6's caption on that box, so the question is quoted from the form's saved text, prototype/expected/source-text/imm5257e.xfa-template.txt). IMM 5257's own Validate stops on each when it is empty (tech lead's Validate, 6 Nov ~03:20 IST). For now the three B116 boxes are asked by the configured checkpoint only ("checkpointOnly"; tech lead's ruling on #1123, 6 Nov ~07:2x IST, the founder's choice (a)): asking them on the six moves Visitor visa's question list off vv.single-ae2133b8a398, which the six's saved AI pairs (conditions 83a49fd2, PQR picks fc52039a) read, and a paid re-run on the new list (6 Nov, US$0.56) no longer proposed the conditions B114 and B88 are built on. Adding them to the six with a better-checked paid run is a hardening item. QA-165 (tech lead's brief, 8 Nov 2026; diagnosis on #1256): "followUps" lists, per Yes/No box, the questions the form asks only after a Yes. Each pair is the form's own, never guessed (AGENTS rule 4): the box's field map derivation names one of them (IMM 5257 (09-2023): "derived:any(person.other_family_name, person.other_given_names) recorded", "derived:person.national_id_number recorded", "derived:valid person.us_green_card_number recorded"), and every other one is a form field inside the Yes/No box's own block of the form (AliasName[0], natID[0].natIDdocs[0], USCard[0].usCarddocs[0]); the configured checkpoint's step 230 refuses any follow-up that is neither. The checkpoint gives each the question condition "show only when <the Yes/No question> is Yes" (Questionnaires › the question's condition), so a No hides them and writes N. QA-165's last two (tech lead, Lead 35, on #1363, 8 Nov 2026): IMM 5257's Passport Question 5 (Taiwan PIN) and Question 6 (National Israeli passport) are Yes/No form fields nothing fills, which the form's own script requires only for one country or territory of issue (samples/form-script-requirements.json, CR 330212: code 203, "TWN (Taiwan)", and 206, "ISR (Israel)", in the form's own country list). Each is asked as its own question in the form's words (quoted from its saved text, page 2), checkpointOnly as B116's, and "askedWhen" gives it the question condition "show only when the passport's country or territory of issue is <that one>": the configured checkpoint's step 230 sets it only when the form's script names that condition for that form field (askedWhenGround), so for any other passport neither is asked nor written. QA-318 (C7.2; Lead 37, 9 Nov 2026; P-46, P-171): IMM 5257 SCH1 (09-2023), another form Visitor visa files for each adult ("form"), has two mandatory Yes/No form fields nothing filled: Question 5 "Have you ever witnessed or participated in the ill treatment of prisoners or civilians, looting or desecration of religious buildings?" and Question 6 "Are you, or have you ever been a member or associated with any political party, or other group or organization which has engaged in or advocated violence as a means to achieving a political or religious objective, or which has been associated with criminal activity at any time?", each quoted from the form's saved text (prototype/expected/source-text/imm5257_1e.xfa-template.txt). IMM 5257 already asks both questions, in the same words, of the same person (its own Yes/No "Ill treatment of prisoners or civilians", B116, and its Background information field person.violent_organization_association), so each SCH1 box is pointed at that same library field ("field", else the field of the same label): one answer fills both forms, never two answers that can disagree (review M1 on #1272). Each is asked as its own question in those words, on the configured checkpoint only ("checkpointOnly", for B116's reason). Their details (Question 5's table is filled by hand; Question 6's organizations) are not conditioned on them here. Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. BK-25 (P-533, P-542, P-449: data; BK-24's follow-ups F2 and F5): the Study permit (sp.outside) asks the same three questions IMM 5257 asks under B116, which IMM 1294 (06-2026) and IMM 1295 (09-2023) leave with no decision in their saved AI answers and whose own Validate requires (BK-24's check, our XFA engine's run of IMM 1295's own Validate): Background information Question 2 c) "Have you previously applied to enter or remain in Canada?" (the field IMM 5257 maps to the same question), Question 6 "Have you ever witnessed or participated in the ill treatment of prisoners or civilians, looting or desecration of religious buildings?" and the consent to be contacted, each in its form's own words (IMM 1294 prints CIC, IMM 1295 IRCC; quoted from the forms' saved text, prototype/expected/source-text/imm1294e.xfa-template.txt and imm1295e.xfa-template.txt, as the readings print a neighbour's words on these boxes), so one answer fills every form that asks it; checkpointOnly, for B116's reason. Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. BK-25 (F4): IMM 5707 (01-2023), which the Study permit files for the student and the spouse, prints "I was physically present at the marriage ceremony" (the applicant's row) and "My spouse was physically present at the marriage ceremony" (the spouse's row) as statements answered YES or NO, which its own Validate (validEntry.validateFields) requires of a married applicant and spouse. Each is asked in those words, quoted from the form's saved text (prototype/expected/source-text/imm5707e.xfa-template.txt), as one new person field; the spouse's row is about the spouse ("person": the role its row's other form fields name, which the door checks), so each person answers once, for their own copy and their spouse's. Sample, Unconfirmed: expert. P-598 (tech lead on #1747, 14 Nov): IMM 5707 (01-2023) is one edition every paper combination files (the family information form), and a reviewed release is never edited (P-487 (3); P-496 (1)'s check keeps the other combinations' releases byte-identical), so its two boxes are "later": asked only after every other combination's release 1, and their combination released after them (api/src/features/checkpoint/110-release-one.ts). The other combinations that file IMM 5707 pick the question up at their next release.
